scope: Read-only audit of the current aggregator and native-exact-attempts-r02; no source, runtime, aggregator, or baseline changes.

findings.finding: native_matched is keyed only by source frame number. A verified attempt at frame 1070 can therefore mark every inventory row with frame 1070 as native_matched regardless of kind, slot, fixture, or runtime revision.
findings.evidence: aggregate_lee_callback_inventory.py:149-163; native-exact-attempts-r02 contains a p1 1070 pair but no comparator artifact keyed by fixture and runtime hash.
findings.required_fix: Key evidence by (fixture_id, slot, source_path, source_frame, kind), then require the same key in the row; never promote a frame-global set.

findings.finding: The 1070 attempt is an observed native callback pair with source_corresponding values and matched_fields [source_frame, entering, action, ql], but it is not a field-by-field compare result: native-exact-attempts-r02 has no runtime/main/helper/runner hash, no explicit diff list, and no current comparator result.
findings.evidence: evidence/characters/lee/callback-exact-r01/native-exact-attempts-r02.json attempt fixture_log ...target1070.log; the log has LEE_EXACT_CALLBACK lines and MOVE_CASE_REFERENCE_OK only.
findings.required_fix: Keep 1070 as native_exact_observed until a comparator record binds source raw, native output, fixture/build, current runtime and runner hashes and reports zero differences.

findings.finding: The comparator promotion condition accepts callback_sequence_match or a matched_fields set without requiring verified status, fixture identity, current runtime provenance, or differences == 0.
findings.required_fix: Require an explicit verified/accepted comparator status plus exact fixture/source/native hashes, current runtime provenance, and zero differences.

findings.finding: Payload slot is read but not validated against the build/index-resolved Lee slot. A mislabeled body_boundary payload can be counted as Lee evidence; _build_slot also continues past malformed builds and a later override can mask the malformed provenance.
findings.evidence: aggregate_lee_callback_inventory.py:78-90 and 115-136; overrides are path-to-slot strings without content/build hashes.
findings.required_fix: Require payload slot == resolved slot and reject unknown/mismatched slots; malformed build metadata must be an error, never fall through to an override without an explicit audited exception.

findings.finding: 1098 source frame and child clip are distinct in the raw clip report, but frame-global native matching and body-marker fallback can erase that distinction. The source report proves separate events: frame_1098/DoAction at sequences 13560-13563 and frame_1098/PlaceObject2_18_29 clip at 13566-13567 onward.
findings.required_fix: Match source_path/kind/placement identity, not frame number alone; a body_boundary marker must never satisfy a clip_action row.

findings.finding: _legacy_slot is dead code: it is defined but never called by main. Several override paths also contain duplicate events.jsonl/events.jsonl forms and an ignored recovery path, making provenance hard to audit.
findings.required_fix: Either remove the dead fallback or call it through an explicit audited path; normalize and hash every override target.

findings.finding: known-case assertions require exact source_only status for 1088/1098 clip rows. A future correctly verified native match would make the assertion fail instead of accepting the stronger status.
findings.required_fix: Assert status in an allowed ordered set, e.g. native_matched or source_only, while separately requiring provenance for native_matched.

case_conclusions.1070: Observed source/native callback-shaped data, not accepted field comparison; current runtime provenance is insufficient.
case_conclusions.1098: Frame DoAction and PlaceObject2_18_29 clip are genuinely distinguished in clip-action-gap-r01 raw events; current aggregate logic is unsafe because its native path is frame-global and its fallback is not kind-safe.
case_conclusions.override: Path-only slot overrides are not sufficient identity evidence for acceptance; they need fixture/build/content hashes and payload-slot agreement.
